content.comment_body: If we use commercial products that include [product_name], what are the recommended methods for protecting the installed program from unauthorized copying?
You can enable password protection for your program and utilize copy protection features for an SD card, if you are working with SD card storage.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in effective ways to secure intellectual property when deploying solutions with [product_name] controllers.
